note: Frozen eval subset. Small work (11 chunks); several chunks are the modern editor's commentary rather than Dionysius's text.

queries.query: the counsel of Dionysius's Mystical Theology: pray to enter the divine darkness, where giving up both seeing and knowing is itself the truest way of seeing God
queries.note: The prayer to enter the Darkness beyond Light; 'Gloom', 'emptying of our faculties', 'loss of sight and knowledge' paraphrased away. First draft anchored only on 'Dionysius' passed tradition but the work itself missed top-15 (Boehme and neoplatonist works came back); the treatise title added as anchor.

queries.query: why the Mystical Theology grows briefer as it climbs: descending from God the concepts multiply, but the upward path sheds words until the ascent ends in complete silence
queries.note: The contracting-terminology passage; 'ever-widening number of conceptions', 'contracts its terminology', 'totally dumb' paraphrased away; the treatise's title kept as a reader-honest anchor.

queries.query: can the ultimate reality be described in words at all, or only pointed to by denial
queries.note: Ineffability and the negative way; answered by daoist, vedantic, buddhist and sufi material too. No target — graded post-hoc.
